title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Workforce Insights agent for leaders, managers and delegates
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing and actionable controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the access-policy route and reconcile checklist configuration steps with the controls table. The earlier verifier comment was treated as history, not instructions or evidence.

claims.claim: Organization context changes can take up to 15 minutes to take effect.

claims.quote: Searched: the full workforce-insights-agent page for the delegation-control command. Read Manage delegation policies: it identifies Microsoft 365 feature-access PowerShell and WorkforceInsights but prints no cmdlet or parameters for disabling assignment.

claims.claim: The agent does not use custom columns without a confirmed description.

claims.claim: Learn's context, prompt and disclaimer configuration instructions begin at the Workforce Insights home page, rather than giving a full admin-center navigation route.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center as an admin. ... Go to the Workforce Insights homepage.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist's configuration controls are all represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Assign AI Administrator and Organizational Data Source Administrator; copy them to renamed custom fields; Confirm an attribute description; Publish organisation context ... prompts and ... disclaimer. The table covers only installation, blocking, access policies and delegation.
claims.fix: The role-assignment, reserved-field migration, attribute-description and context/prompt/disclaimer checklist steps have no corresponding controls-table rows. Remove those four configuration bullets from the checklist, retaining their documented explanations elsewhere; do not add rows.
